interaction.prompt: Your teammate is stuck with the puck on the boards with two checkers. Tap the open ice you should skate to instead of the crowded corner.

mc.stem: Your teammate is stuck on the boards. You are the other player without the puck, skating toward the same corner. What are you doing wrong?
opts: Skating into the crowd instead of staying in open ice
Skating too far from the puck to touch it right away
Skating right next to my teammate so I can get the rebound
Slowing down so I don't run into the defenders

feedback.right: Yes. Two players in one corner just makes a bigger crowd. Skate to the open middle so your teammate has somewhere to pass.
feedback.wrong: Skating into the same corner makes the crowd bigger and gives your teammate nowhere to pass. The open ice in the middle is the better spot.

tip: When a teammate is stuck in a crowd, skate to open space so they have somewhere to pass.
why: Young players swarm the puck. Finding open ice away from the battle creates a passing option and spreads the play out.
